referents.why: 'Him' (auton), masculine singular object of 'handed over', is Jesus, the one delivered up; Jesus is offered as a candidate
referents.category: object pronoun resolved to named person in an earlier verse

referents.why: 'he' (implied subject of 'was aware', third singular) is Pilate, who asked the question that this verse explains
referents.category: implied subject carried from the verse before

links.why: 'he was aware that' ... handed Jesus over: the clause is the object of knowing (hoti after a verb of knowing)
links.category: clause as object of a verb of knowing

links.why: self-link; the reason is not inside this clause

the verse-opening gar is 'for': this verse gives the reason for Pilate's question in 15.9 ('he asked, because he knew it was envy'); the explained clause is the earlier one, so the edge runs from it to this reason
links.category: verse-opening for explains the verse before
